content: go-enry (go-enry/go-enry, v2, 622 stars, Apache-2.0) is a port of GitHub Linguist for per-FILE language classification: enry.GetLanguage(filename string, content []byte) string returns the language or empty, never errors; helpers IsBinary/IsVendor/IsConfiguration/IsDocumentation/IsDotFile/IsImage/IsTest/IsGenerated; strategies by filename/extension/shebang/content heuristics; language data is generated from linguist YAML into an embedded data package; some linguist heuristics use regex not supported by RE2 (optional oniguruma). Wrong abstraction for project_probe: it classifies individual files by content/extension and knows nothing about project manifests (go.mod module path, package.json name/version, pyproject.toml metadata) or project-level metadata (name, version, description). src-d/enry is abandoned; development continues at go-enry/go-enry.
